instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The Sundarbans are a group of mangrove forests that span across the coastlines of India and Bangladesh. They are vital to the local communities as they protect them from floods and coastal erosion, as well as providing habitats for fish that the locals can hunt.

Rising sea levels now put mangroves at risk of being fully submerged in water for longer periods, which can drown them. Without the trees, locals would face a greater risk of flooding and would lose their hunting grounds.

atoms.a: How do the Sundarbans help the local community?
What will happen if sea levels keep rising?
b: The mangroves will grow white flowers.
The mangroves will not be harmed.
